title: Hello_In_Ten_Languages_5eca43d9
style: Global pop anthem with hip-hop and world music influences. The track features a driving four-on-the-floor kick drum, syncopated handclaps, and a prominent brass section playing staccato fanfares. A distorted electric guitar provides rhythmic power chords during the chorus. The bass is a thick, sub-heavy synth that follows the kick pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, chant-like style with multiple layers of backing vocals creating a stadium-crowd effect. The tempo is 128 BPM in the key of G major. High-energy percussion including shakers and tambourines fill the high-end frequency spectrum.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[staccato brass fanfare, driving kick drum, handclaps]
Hello! [shouted]
That's where it starts
One word, one open heart
In any language, first word counts
Learn it, that's what mounts

[Chorus]
[full band enters, distorted guitar, heavy synth bass]
Kia ora! Hola! Konnichiwa! Saubona!
Bonjour! Marhaba! Namaste! Jidde!
Jidde!

[Verse 1]
[drums continue, brass hits on off-beats]
The first word is the whole game
Say it in the tongue, not the same
Respect teaches you the greeting
Before the first meeting
Muscle voice in your language
Carry on your name's heritage
One word, respect established
Get cultured, it's accomplished

[Chorus]
[brass fanfare, heavy percussion]
Hello! Hola! Kia ora! Konnichiwa!
Saubona! Jidde!
Kia ora! Hola! Konnichiwa! Saubona!
Bonjour! Marhaba! Namaste! Kia ora!
Kia ora!

[Bridge]
[rapid vocal delivery, rhythmic synth pulse]
Hello, Hola, Kia, Hola, Konnichiwa, Saubona, Jidde
Hello, Hola, Kia, Hola, Konnichiwa, Saubona, Jidde

[Chorus]
[maximum intensity, layered vocals, brass section]
Kia ora! Hola! Konnichiwa! Saubona!
Bonjour! Marhaba! Namaste! Kia ora!
Kia ora! [final brass hit]
